description: Landesplanung - VG_Hochwasserschutz-VH - OGC API Features is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The Map Service (WFS Group) provides the map bases of the Land Development Plan Environment (2004) and Settlement (2006) of the Saarland.:Area-wide representation of priority areas for flood protection (VH) within the framework of the LEP Environment 2004. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Land Planning - VG _Flood Protection VH - OGC API Features" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Raumordnung, Landesplanung, opendata, inspireidentifiziert, infoFeatureAccessService, landesplanung. The listing shows 2025-02-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
